errors.text_span: Each year is associated with a pair of bars
errors.evidence: This is an overgeneralization. The years 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, and 2016 each have only a single bar, not a pair.

errors.text_span: with a slight decrease in 2022 to around 40 (light blue shading)
errors.evidence: The light blue bar for 2022 corresponds to a value of approximately 30 on the logarithmic y-axis, not 40.

errors.text_span: increase to a maximum of around 40 in 2020
errors.evidence: The orange bar for multilingual datasets in 2020 reaches a value of approximately 20, not 40. The description overestimates this value by a factor of two.
